dialect.detail: IBM mainframe style VSAM KSDS indexed file I/O subprogram; uses RETURN-CODE special register, GOBACK, COMP-3, fixed format, typical of IBM Enterprise COBOL
evidence: ORGANIZATION IS INDEXED with VSAM comment

purpose.domain_detail: Customer record management with ID, currency, name, birthday, and balance fields suggesting a banking or financial account system
purpose.summary: A subprogram (PBEGIDX) that provides VSAM KSDS indexed file I/O services (open, read, update, write, delete, close) dispatched via a function code passed in the linkage section. It supports reading customer records by key, updating names with character transformations, writing new records, and deleting records.

notable_features: VSAM KSDS indexed file with composite key (IDX-ID + IDX-CURRENCY)
COMP-3 packed decimal fields for ID, birthday, balance
LINKAGE SECTION with function-code dispatch pattern
REWRITE and DELETE for VSAM record maintenance
88-level condition names for function codes and file status
verdict.notes: Author name 'TOLGA KAYIS' is hardcoded in H700-WRITE as the written record value, suggesting this is a student exercise or personal learning project. The H300-INVALID-KEY and H250-VALID-KEY paragraphs have identical logic which may be intentional for the exercise. Dialect is likely IBM mainframe based on VSAM usage and RETURN-CODE, but could also compile under GnuCOBOL.
